identitySignals: Name matches exactly: the agenda says 'Apena Engineering, Inc.' and the company's own website footer says 'APENA Engineering, Inc.'
A California general corporation with the same name is registered in San Leandro, CA (entity no. 5563271, active, per a registry-data aggregator), so it is in the Bay Area near Oakland
The website describes a Bay Area general engineering contractor doing grading, paving and underground utility work. That is plausible for a demolition and site contract with OUSD Facilities
The company has bid on other East Bay public-agency projects, including the City of San Leandro. I found no page that links it directly to OUSD.
research.notes: Confidence is medium because I found no page directly tying this company to OUSD or the Ethel Moore demolition. The California entity number and address come from a third-party aggregator of Secretary of State data (bizprofile.net), not the Secretary of State site itself. A phone number, (510) 575-2547, appears in directory listings but not on the company's own website, so I left it null. The EIN and SAM UEI were not found. The name on the registry differs slightly from the agenda ('Apena Engineering Inc.' without the comma).

profile.summary: A Bay Area general engineering contractor. It specializes in small-to-medium grading and paving projects, plus underground utility installation and repair. It says it is licensed to work throughout California.
